topics.title: Converting Metric Units
topics.concept:
The Metric System

The metric system is based on powers of 10 — it's easy to convert!

Metric Length Conversions:

UnitAbbreviationRelation
Kilometerkm1 km = 1000 m
Meterm1 m = 100 cm
Centimetercm1 cm = 10 mm
Millimetermmsmallest unit

Metric Mass (Weight) Conversions:

UnitAbbreviationRelation
Kilogramkg1 kg = 1000 g
Gramg1 g = 1000 mg

Metric Capacity (Volume) Conversions:

UnitAbbreviationRelation
LiterL1 L = 1000 mL
MillilitermLsmallest

Conversion Rule:

  • Large → Small: Multiply (×)
  • Small → Large: Divide (÷)

examples.solution:
• cm → m: divide by 100 (or multiply by 0.01)
  • 450 ÷ 100 = 4.5

topics.title: Converting Time - Hours & Minutes
topics.concept:
Time Conversions:

RelationConversion
1 hour = 60 minutes×60 or ÷60
1 minute = 60 seconds×60 or ÷60
1 day = 24 hours×24 or ÷24

Converting Hours to Minutes:

  • Hours → Minutes: multiply by 60
  • Example: 2.5 hours = 2.5 × 60 = 150 minutes

Converting Minutes to Hours:

  • Minutes → Hours: divide by 60
  • Example: 180 minutes = 180 ÷ 60 = 3 hours

Decimals vs. Minutes:

  • 0.5 hour = ½ hour = 30 minutes
  • 0.25 hour = ¼ hour = 15 minutes
  • 0.75 hour = ¾ hour = 45 minutes
topics.visual:
HOUR TO MINUTES CONVERSION:

    1 hour = 60 minutes
    
    0.25 hour (¼) = 15 minutes
    0.5 hour (½)  = 30 minutes
    0.75 hour (¾) = 45 minutes
    1.0 hour      = 60 minutes
    1.5 hours     = 90 minutes
    2.0 hours     = 120 minutes
    2.5 hours     = 150 minutes


TIME CONVERSION CLOCK:

           12
        11    1
      10        2
     9          3
      8        4
        7    5
           6
    
    Each number = 5 minutes
    Full circle = 60 minutes = 1 hour


CONVERTING 2.5 HOURS TO MINUTES:

    2.5 hours = 2 hours + 0.5 hours
               = (2 × 60) + (0.5 × 60)
               = 120 + 30
               = 150 minutes


CONVERTING 165 MINUTES TO HOURS:

    165 minutes ÷ 60 = 2.75 hours
    2.75 hours = 2 hours + 0.75 hours
               = 2 hours + 45 minutes
               = 2 hours 45 minutes

examples.solution:
• 2 hours = 120 minutes
  • ¾ hour = 45 minutes
  • Total = 120 + 45 = 165
  • Answer: 165 minutes

examples.problem: A movie is 150 minutes. How many hours is that?
